description:
## Goal
Move this monorepo off the deprecated `@mariozechner/*` Pi packages (0.67.3) onto current `@earendil-works/*` at 0.84.3, and keep lint/tests/typecheck green.

## Background
- Pi moved to Earendil Works at 0.74.0. 0.73.1 was the last `@mariozechner` release.
- This repo still pins `@mariozechner/pi-{ai,coding-agent,tui,agent-core}` at ^0.67.3.
- Stay on `@earendil-works` (not a later hypothetical rename). Do not keep Mario aliases.

## Locked migrations
- `@mariozechner/pi-*` → `@earendil-works/pi-*` (peer + devDeps + imports)
- `@sinclair/typebox` 0.34 → `typebox` 1.x (official extension schema import)
- `Type`/`Static` tool schemas import from `typebox`; `StringEnum` stays on `@earendil-works/pi-ai`
- `complete`, `completeSimple`, `getModel`, `registerFauxProvider` import from `@earendil-works/pi-ai/compat`
- Root workspace pins `^0.84.3`; workspace packages keep `"*"` peer/dev ranges
- tsdown `neverBundle` matches `/^@earendil-works\//` and `typebox`
- `createAgentSession` no longer accepts `modelRegistry`/`authStorage`; use `ModelRuntime` (or omit for default)
- `AuthStorage` / `ModelRegistry.create()` are gone from the public SDK
- `ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders()` headers may be `string | null`
- Node engines should match Pi: `>=22.19.0`

## Out of scope
- Feature work, TUI redesign, OM mastra backlog, beadwork overlay rebuild
- Migrating anything besides Pi runtime deps unless required for compile/test

## Acceptance
- `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run typecheck` all pass
- No remaining `@mariozechner/pi-*` or `@sinclair/typebox` in source/package.json (lockfile transitives of other tools are ok)
title: Migrate Pi deps from @mariozechner 0.67.3 to @earendil-works 0.84.3
